answer: Long unstaking cooldowns close the hit-and-run exit for fake identities. A leaving identity waits six epochs, its stake slashable throughout. The exit is a terrace: stake unlocks in stages, and a challenge at any stage freezes release. A rising tide of challenges can still arrive during the wait. Each request carries a crystal record of key and stake, so capital cannot be reused for a new fake. Failure mode exit rotation: rotating identities leaves each stake locked. At 80 credits each, 1,000 fakes tie up 80,000 credits for six epochs, while an honest agent pays one lock.
